summary: Iteration 108: Future Skills CRM (Leads/Trials/Customers/Renewals/Lost) fully tested — backend 24/24 pytest cases pass; frontend UI verified end-to-end via Playwright (login → 5 tabs with badges → add lead → drawer → overdue bucket).

minor.issue: status=all with additional filter combinations not tested — only smoke tests for status=new/all/q ran.
Falls back to allowing any email ending in @oll.co — good for tests but a soft authz weakness (documented, not blocking).

critical_code_review_comments: future_skills.py is now 1308 lines — recommend splitting admin CRM endpoints into a separate module (e.g. future_skills_admin.py) for maintainability.
_add_months uses 30*days approximation for monthly/half-yearly/yearly which drifts from calendar months (Feb-only edge etc.). Acceptable for MVP but flag for later.
Frontend AdminFutureSkills.jsx is 1061 lines with 5 tabs + drawer + 6 modals inside one file — consider splitting into subcomponents per tab.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed leads/trials/customers via backend tests and one TEST_UI_Lead2 lead via UI. Non-blocking for future runs (import test uses timestamp-based phone numbers to avoid dedup collision).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints tested: POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE /admin/future-skills/leads, /leads/{id}/mark-lost, /leads/{id}/convert-to-trial, /leads/import (CSV, dedup on phone, bad-file 400), /trials (create + mark-lost + convert-to-customer with plan_label), /customers (create with auto renewal_date), /customers/{id}/renew (renewal_history append + extends from future/past base), /customers/{id}/mark-lost, /renewals?bucket=upcoming|overdue|all (7-day window, days_to_renewal/days_overdue), /lost?type=all|lead|trial|customer, /stats, PATCH /subscriptions/{id} refreshes plan_label. Auth: 401/403 on missing/bad token. half_yearly plan (₹11000, 6 months) verified. Frontend: all 5 tabs render with badge counts; add-lead modal creates successfully; detail drawer for customer shows Renew + Mark Lost buttons; renewal-bucket-all/upcoming/overdue buttons visible only on Renewals tab (correct behavior); Import CSV modal has download-sample and import-file-input.
